136. Word Position in String

50

Medium  Topics

Problem Statement:
Given 2 strings S and X print the word position of X in S.(word count starts from 1).If the given word doesn't exists in S print '-1'.
input_spec: The input consists of 2 strings S and X. The size of S and X are between 1 and 1000 characters (1 <= |s|, |x| <= 1000).
output_spec: The output is the word position of X in S (starting from 1), or -1 if X is not found.
